scope: Account entry, authentication, member profile, security, training data and privacy controls in Account.jsx

statusLegend.NOT TESTED: No interaction evidence has been recorded.
statusLegend.PARTIAL: A focused browser test covered only the evidence named here.
statusLegend.PASS: The complete control path, including success and failure handling, was verified against its required backend state.

controls.label: Account
controls.expected: Opens the Account route on desktop and mobile navigation.
controls.evidence: tests/accounts-ui.spec.js opens the route in Chromium.

controls.label: New to FORMA? Create account
controls.expected: Shows registration fields and password guidance.
controls.evidence: tests/accounts-ui.spec.js opens the registration form and validates the password length constraint.

controls.label: Display name
controls.expected: Requires a non-empty member display name and limits it to 50 characters.
controls.evidence: Filled by tests/accounts-ui.spec.js; whitespace validation and server response are NOT TESTED.

controls.label: Email address
controls.expected: Uses native email validation and submits the address with registration.
controls.evidence: Filled by tests/accounts-ui.spec.js; server response is NOT TESTED.

controls.label: Password
controls.expected: Requires at least 15 characters and allows long passphrases.
controls.evidence: tests/accounts-ui.spec.js confirms a short value is invalid in Chromium.

controls.label: Create account
controls.expected: Calls signUp and gives non-enumerating verification guidance.

controls.label: Already have an account? Sign in
controls.expected: Returns to sign-in mode.
controls.evidence: tests/accounts-ui.spec.js returns to the Welcome back form in Chromium.

controls.label: Email address
controls.expected: Accepts the member email for authentication.

controls.label: Password
controls.expected: Accepts current password with password-manager support.

controls.label: Sign in
controls.expected: Restores authenticated session or opens required MFA challenge.

controls.label: Resend verification
controls.prerequisite: Sign-in form with an email address entered
controls.expected: Requests verification email with generic response copy to avoid account enumeration.

controls.label: Forgot password?
controls.expected: Opens reset request form.
controls.evidence: tests/accounts-ui.spec.js opens the reset request form in Chromium.

controls.label: Email address
controls.expected: Requests a reset link without disclosing whether the account exists.
controls.evidence: Presence asserted by tests/accounts-ui.spec.js; submission NOT TESTED.

controls.label: Send reset link
controls.expected: Requests reset email through Better Auth.

controls.label: New password
controls.expected: Requires at least 15 characters before resetting password.

controls.label: Update password
controls.expected: Resets password and returns to sign-in.

controls.label: Authenticator code or Recovery code
controls.expected: Accepts second-factor code without showing authenticated content early.

controls.label: Use authenticator code / Use recovery code
controls.expected: Switches between authenticator and single-use recovery code entry.

controls.label: Verify and sign in
controls.prerequisite: Sign-in MFA challenge with valid code
controls.expected: Completes Better Auth's second-factor step and restores the session.

controls.label: Continue as guest
controls.expected: Returns to the guest workout overview.

controls.label: Overview
controls.expected: Shows metrics derived from the signed-in member's workspace.

controls.label: Profile
controls.expected: Shows editable member details and training goal.

controls.label: Display name
controls.expected: Updates Better Auth profile name.

controls.label: Weekly workout goal
controls.expected: Persists a 1–7 sessions per week goal to member workspace.

controls.label: Save changes
controls.expected: Saves profile and goal with success/failure feedback.

controls.label: Cancel changes
controls.prerequisite: Profile section with an unsaved name or goal change
controls.expected: Restores the latest saved profile and training goal without a backend write.

controls.label: New email address
controls.expected: Validates new address before requesting secure verification.

controls.label: Confirm your password
controls.expected: Requires current password for email change.

controls.label: Send verification
controls.expected: Requests email change and waits for address verification.

controls.label: Security
controls.expected: Shows password, MFA and sanitized sessions settings.

controls.label: Current password
controls.expected: Provides step-up proof for password change.

controls.label: New password
controls.expected: Requires at least 15 characters.

controls.label: Confirm new password
controls.expected: Requires a match before submission.

controls.label: Update password
controls.prerequisite: Valid current and matching new password
controls.expected: Updates password and revokes other sessions.

controls.label: Confirm your password
controls.expected: Requires recent authentication before TOTP enrollment.

controls.label: Set up authenticator
controls.expected: Starts TOTP setup and displays the secret only for enrollment.

controls.label: Authenticator code
controls.expected: Accepts six digit TOTP code.

controls.label: Verify and enable
controls.expected: Confirms enrollment and exposes backup codes once.

controls.label: View recovery codes
controls.prerequisite: MFA enabled and recent password confirmation
controls.expected: Generates and displays recovery codes once.

controls.label: Download codes
controls.expected: Downloads codes as a local text file.

controls.label: Turn off
controls.expected: Disables TOTP only after successful step-up authentication.

controls.label: Refresh sessions
controls.expected: Reloads sanitized session list without exposing tokens or internal IDs.

controls.label: Revoke
controls.expected: Revokes only the selected session.

controls.label: Sign out other devices
controls.prerequisite: At least one other active session and confirmation
controls.expected: Revokes every other session after service authorization.

controls.label: Sign out everywhere
controls.expected: Revokes all sessions and clears the local authenticated view.

controls.label: Training data
controls.expected: Shows account-scoped routines, workout history and sync state.

controls.label: Export my data
controls.expected: Downloads a JSON export from the account service.

controls.label: Import workout backup
controls.expected: Validates backup and opens review without writing immediately.

controls.label: Review local data
controls.expected: Shows counts and asks for explicit confirmation before cloud replacement.

controls.label: I reviewed the counts and saved a copy of my current cloud training data.
controls.expected: Explicitly acknowledges the replacement after the current cloud export is downloaded.

controls.label: Import to account
controls.expected: Imports only after explicit confirmation and current-cloud export; reports errors without data loss claims.

controls.label: Download current cloud copy before replacing / Cloud copy downloaded
controls.expected: Downloads the existing cloud data and enables replacement only after export succeeds.

controls.label: Cancel
controls.expected: Closes review without replacing cloud data.

controls.label: Reload cloud data
controls.expected: Reloads only after explicit acknowledgement that the unsynced edits will be replaced by cloud state.

controls.label: Export my unsynced changes
controls.prerequisite: Unresolved sync conflict with attempted payload available
controls.expected: Downloads the attempted member data as JSON before reload.

controls.label: I understand reloading replaces my unsynced edits.
controls.expected: Requires explicit acknowledgement before reload is enabled.

controls.label: Open routines
controls.expected: Navigates to the member's routines in the workout workspace.

controls.label: Open history
controls.expected: Navigates to the member's workout history.

controls.label: Privacy
controls.expected: Shows storage, export, logout and account deletion information.

controls.label: Sign out
controls.expected: Ends current session and clears private workspace view.

controls.label: Review account deletion
controls.expected: Opens password and explicit DELETE confirmation fields.

controls.label: Confirm your password
controls.expected: Requires password confirmation.

controls.label: Type DELETE to confirm
controls.expected: Requires exact DELETE phrase.

controls.label: Cancel
controls.expected: Closes deletion review without changing account state.

controls.label: Send confirmation email
controls.prerequisite: Valid password and exact DELETE phrase
controls.expected: Requests Better Auth deletion email; states that account remains active until the confirmation link is used.
